title: Motorways & Smart Motorways
whatItIs: Fast roads with their own rules: who may use them, joining and leaving, lane discipline, red X lane closures, hard shoulders and emergency areas.

keyFacts.text: Learners MUST NOT drive on a motorway unless with an ADI, in a dual-controlled car with L (or D) plates.

keyFacts: Joining: give priority to traffic already on the motorway and match your speed to the left lane.

keyFacts.text: You MUST NOT drive in a lane closed by a red X or red flashing lights.
You MUST NOT use a hard shoulder except in an emergency, or when directed by police, traffic officers or a sign.

keyFacts: Keep in the left lane unless overtaking, and overtake only on the right.

keyFacts.text: You MUST NOT reverse, cross the central reservation or drive against the traffic flow.

visual.caption: Smart motorway signals and lanes (Highway Code rules 258, 265, 269, 270)

items.title: Red X or red flashing lights
items.text: The lane is closed: you MUST NOT drive in it. A speed limit or 'END' shows it has reopened.

items.title: Hard shoulder used as a lane
items.text: Only when a speed limit shows above it. A red X or blank sign: emergencies only.

items.title: Emergency areas
items.text: Blue signs with an orange SOS phone. Emergency use only; use the phone before you rejoin.

items.title: Right-hand lane bans
items.text: On 3+ lanes, vehicles towing trailers and larger goods or passenger vehicles MUST NOT use it.

a.label: Hard shoulder
points: Emergencies only, unless directed or a speed limit shows above it
Less protection: very close to high-speed traffic

b.label: Emergency area
points: Blue sign with an orange SOS phone; may have orange surfacing
You MUST use the emergency phone before rejoining

onTheTest.question: Your pupil holds a provisional car licence and wants motorway experience. Which is required?
options: Any qualified driver aged 21+ in the passenger seat
An ADI, a car with dual controls and L (or D) plates
A theory test pass and a supervisor
onTheTest.why: Rule 253: provisional car licence holders MUST NOT drive on the motorway unless accompanied by an ADI in a car with dual controls displaying red L plates (D plates in Wales).

onTheTest.question: A sign above the left lane shows a red X. What must your pupil do?
options: Slow down and stay in the lane
Move to an open lane in good time and not drive in the closed lane
Use the hard shoulder to pass the closure
Switch on hazard lights and carry on
onTheTest.why: Rule 258: a red X identifies a closed lane where people, stopped vehicles or hazards may be. You MUST follow the signs to an open lane and MUST NOT drive in the closed lane.

traps: Missed your exit? Carry on to the next one: never reverse on any part of a motorway, including slip roads.
After leaving, 50 mph can feel like 30 mph: check the speedometer and slow for sharp bends.
Amber flashing lights: only speed up after a signal that isn't flashing, a national limit or 'END'.
Smart motorways can change limits and lane use: the national standard says obeying them is vital.
